title: ClientSideTiers
description: ClientSideTiers lets you assign local-only PvP tier tags to yourself or other online players, visible only on your client.
body:
# ClientSideTiers

## About

ClientSideTiers is a client-side Minecraft mod that lets you manually apply PvP tier tags to yourself or other online players.

Everything is local-only, meaning only you can see the tier tags. Other players will not see your changes.

The tier appears on the far left of the player name in the official TierTagger-style format:

`HT1 | PlayerName`

## Features

- Client-side only tier tags
- Assign tiers to yourself or other online players
- Configurable through Mod Menu
- Online player selection GUI
- Tiers saved per player UUID
- Clear / remove tier option
- Tier appears on the far left of the player name
- Uses official TierTagger-style tier colors
- Works in nametags and player list

## Available Tiers

- HT1
- LT1
- HT2
- LT2
- HT3
- LT3
- HT4
- LT4
- HT5
- LT5

## Important

This mod does not change real tier data and does not affect other players.

All tags are client-side and only visible to you.

## Dependencies

Required:

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Minecraft 1.21.11

Recommended:

- Mod Menu

## Author

Made by BestOfAfrika
